name: Pickled Onions

low.description: Not recommended - no low FODMAP serving

siboNotes: Onions remain high in fructans even when pickled, as the fermentation process doesn't significantly reduce FODMAP content. Best avoided during SIBO treatment phases.
preparationTips: Use garlic-infused oil instead of whole garlic if making homemade
Rinse briefly before use to reduce sodium if needed
Store properly in refrigerator after opening
Consider using the pickling liquid sparingly as a vinegar substitute
